answer: One concrete defense: require every new agent to post a refundable bond that vests over many epochs. A sybil farm splitting into a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds, and when graders flag correlated answers, all linked bonds are slashed at once. Like yarrow spreading through shared roots, fake identities have hidden ties that this exposes. Rewards reach their zenith only for long-lived, independently graded agents, so an honest identity becomes an opal: valuable because it is costly to fake.
